title: Colombini Group — Rovereta 1
description: Virtual tour of the Colombini Group Rovereta 1 production facility — five floors, twelve departments.

variables.name: floor.SITE.body
variables.initial: The production facility seen from the air. Five floors sit inside this building and the panel travels down through all of them: it is cut, squared and edge-banded at the top, worked and assembled on the way, and every floor’s output converges at ground level for dispatch. The tour starts at ground level and works its way up; pick a floor to jump straight to it.

variables.name: floor.P4.body
variables.initial: Floor 4 is the starting point of the internal production chain. Here the Batch 1 Line cuts, squares and edge-bands the panels that feed all the lines of the production facility; the Sirio System and the BACCI Robotic Cart Loading Station then prepare the pallets and trolleys that are subsequently distributed to the departments. It is the floor where the panel is born and sent on to the rest of the factory.

variables.name: floor.P2.title
variables.initial: Components and the logistics hub for semi-finished goods

variables.name: floor.P2.body
variables.initial: Floor 2 brings together production and logistics. The Drawer Production Line produces the drawers destined for the compositions and for other internal departments. From here the Automatic MSL Semi-Finished Goods Warehouse can also be seen which, although it extends vertically across all the floors of the production facility, is shown from this point because it is where it can best be appreciated: it is the “brain” that feeds the Rovereta 1 production facility, storing the semi-finished goods and distributing them to the lines via AGV.

content.title: Sirio System and Robotic Cart Loading Station
content.lead: Automatic system for sorting semi-finished parts from the Batch 1 edge-banding lines and the internal drilling lines. Depending on their family, panels are directed either to the Sirio gantry, which stacks them on pallets, or to the warehouse fitted with the BACCI robot, which loads them directly into the carts destined for the production lines.

content.section.2.item.3: Automatic camera quality control at the edge-banding stage; defective panels go to a manual station

it.var:floor.SITE.body.initial: Lo stabilimento visto dall’alto. All’interno di questo edificio ci sono cinque piani e il pannello li attraversa tutti: all’ultimo piano viene sezionato, squadrato e bordato, lavorato e assemblato lungo il percorso, e la produzione di ogni piano confluisce al piano terra per la spedizione. Il tour parte dal piano terra e sale; scegli un piano per andarci direttamente.
it.var:floor.P4.body.initial: Il piano 4 è il punto di partenza della catena produttiva interna. Qui il reparto Lotto 1 seziona, squadra e borda i pannelli che alimentano tutte le linee dello stabilimento; il sistema Sirio e il magazzino con robot BACCI preparano poi pedane e carrelli che vengono infine distribuiti ai reparti. È il piano in cui il pannello nasce e viene avviato al resto della fabbrica.
it.var:floor.P2.title.initial: Componenti e cuore logistico dei semilavorati
it.var:floor.P2.body.initial: Il piano 2 unisce produzione e logistica. La Linea Cassetti realizza i cassetti destinati alle composizioni e ad altri reparti interni. Da qui si osserva anche il Magazzino dei Semilavorati MSL che, pur sviluppandosi in verticale su tutti i piani dello stabilimento, viene mostrato da questo punto perché è quello da cui si apprezza meglio: è la “mente” che alimenta l’impianto di produzione Rovereta 1, stoccando i semilavorati e distribuendoli alle linee tramite AGV.
it.var:gate.intro.initial: Cinque piani, dodici reparti. Trascina per guardarti intorno, segui i piani sulla sinistra e apri un punto di interesse per leggerne la scheda.
